full_text:
Appendix 2
Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education [Appendix 2] <Amended on January 2, 2026>
Requirements for designation of the National Environmental Education Center (related to Article 18(1))

1. The institution or organization shall fall under any of the following:
(a) An institution affiliated with the State or a local government whose principal purpose of establishment includes environmental education;
(b) A corporation established by the State or a local government to promote projects concerning environmental education;
(c) A nonprofit corporation or nonprofit nongovernmental organization established under the Civil Act or the Assistance for Non-Profit, Non-Governmental Organizations Act whose principal purpose is to carry out projects concerning environmental education.

2. All the following staffing requirements shall be met:
(a) At least two full-time specialists dedicated to environmental education shall be secured ("full-time" includes cases of reduced working hours during the child-rearing period under Article 19-2 of the Equal Employment Opportunity and Work-Family Balance Assistance Act; hereinafter the same shall apply in this Appendix).
(b) At least one full-time manager dedicated to operation of the National Environmental Education Center shall be secured.

3. All the following requirements for facilities and equipment shall be met:
(a) Educational facilities and equipment, such as lecture rooms and practical training areas, that are available for regular use shall be secured.
(b) A management office for operating the National Environmental Education Center shall be secured.
